notes: Value-added classification is a judgment: it provides ship management and charter transport, not warehousing.

logistics_role.detail: Owns and operates very large gas carriers shipping LPG, chiefly US Gulf and Arabian Gulf to Asia.

asset_intensity.detail: Fleet of modern VLGCs, mostly owned with some long-term chartered-in vessels.

value_added.detail: In-house commercial and technical ship management, including vessels in the Helios Pool; vessels chartered out.
